sibling_discovery_mechanism: Decentralized peer discovery via on-chain agent registry. It enumerates agents via `totalSupply` + `tokenByIndex` on the registry contract, fetches each agent's `metadataURI`, and resolves it to live peer info by hitting the agent's `/instance/info` endpoint.
discover_peers_signature: pub async fn discover_peers<P: Provider>(provider: &P, registry: Address, self_address: Option<Address>, max_peers: usize) -> Result<Vec<PeerInfo>, X402Error>
